d: What happens when a cake needs more than frosting, fondant and creativity? Buddy Valastro and the Carlo's Bakery team take on ambitious cake designs that require inventive construction, mechanical elements and spectacular finishing touches. Discover the artistry behind amazing cakes, creative cake designs and elaborate custom creations in Cake Boss Season 9 Episodes 25, 12, 30, 7, 4, 17, 9 and 1 only on discovery+ India.
